column1: # Retrain the two Medium whole-Zoo flows that early-stopped, under a NEW TAG so the
# sealed originals survive for comparison. Medium's flow_k50_codes_pi ran 2570 of
# 20000 epochs and flow_k50_codes_null_ss1 ran 1481, both because the one-off sbatch
# that trained them took train_flow.py's argparse default --patience 400
# instead of flow_arm.sbatch's --patience "$EPOCHS". Every other flow at every scale
# hit the cap. nn_l1/n_train_rows are nan/-1 as in null_b015.tsv: these are not
# leave-one-mixture-out arms, the basis and the training rows are the whole zoo.
# COND_MODE is a job-level env var on purpose (see flow_arm.sbatch): argparse would
# take the last --cond_mode and the winner would depend on argument order.
